name: Republic of Klip River
label: boer states
description: Was a Boer Republic (independent republics formed by Durch-speaking inhabitants of the Cape Colony that wanted to be independent from the British Cape Colony). It was located in Transvaal.

name: Republic of Korea
description: Is a country in East Asia that occupies the southern half of the Korean Peninsula. In 1910 whole Korea was annexed by Japan. After Japan's defeat in World War the Korean Pensinsula was divided in a Soviet and an American occupation zone. The U.S. zone gained independency as the Republic of Korea in 1948.

name: Republic of Korea (Military Occupation)
description: Polity that includes all territories militarly occupied by the Republic of Korea that are not part of a specific military territory.

name: Republic of Kosovo
description: Is a partially recognised state in Southeast Europe. It unilaterally declared its independence from Serbia on 17 February 2008.

name: Republic of Kruševo
description: A short-lived political entity proclaimed in 1903 by rebels from the Secret Macedonian-Adrianople Revolutionary Organization (IMRO) in Kruševo during the anti-Ottoman Ilinden-Preobrazhenie Uprising.

name: Republic of Kyrgyzstan
description: Was the name of Kyrgyzstan before assuming the official name of "Kyrgyz Republic" in 1993.

name: Republic of Latvia
label: baltic states;separatists (russian civil war)
description: Is a country in the Baltic region of Northern Europe. The Republic of Latvia was established a first time on 18 November 1918 when it broke away from the Russian Empire and declared independence in the aftermath of World War I. At the beginning of World War II it was again conquered by the Soviet Union. With the dissolution of the Soviet Union it gained again its independency in 1991.

name: Republic of Liberia
description: Is a country on the West African coast. It is bordered by Sierra Leone to its northwest, Guinea to its north, Ivory Coast to its east, and the Atlantic Ocean to its south and southwest. Liberia emerged from the union of several private colonies founded by the American Colonization Society (ACS). The ACS was an organization that encouraged and supported the migration African-Americans to Africa. The Republic of Liberia declared independence in 1847, being one of the few countries in Africa that remained indepedent since then.

name: Republic of Lijdensrust
label: boer states
description: Was a short-lived Boer republic in the area of present-day Namibia. It was originally named Upingtonia, but changed its name to Lijdensrust.

name: Republic of Lithuania
label: baltic states;separatists (russian civil war)
description: Is a country in the Baltic region of Northern Europe. The Republic of Lithuania was established a first time on 2 November 1918 when it broke away from the Russian Empire and declared independence in the aftermath of World War I. At the beginning of World War II it was again conquered by the Soviet Union. With the dissolution of the Soviet Union it gained again its independency in 1991.

name: Republic of Logone
description: Is a separatist Republic in the Central African Republic.

name: Republic of Macedonia
description: Macedonia, a landlocked country in Southeast Europe, emerged from the dissolution of Yugoslavia. It became independent after a referendum in 1991. Due to a dispute with Greece, in February 2019 the country renamed iteslf "Republic of North Macedonia".

name: Republic of Madagascar
description: Is a country in Africa that occupies the whole island of Madagascar. In precolonial times the island was fragmented in several polities, Imerina being the largest of them. France united Madagascar into the Colony of French Madagascar by the early XX century. Madagascar gained its indepedency in 1960. Its actual consitution and name were adopted in 1975.

name: Narentine State
description: The Narentines were a South Slavic tribe that occupied an area of southern Dalmatia centered at the river Neretva (Narenta), active in the 9th and 10th centuries. They were defeated and conquered by the Republic of Venice.

name: Republic of Kurdistan
label: modern kurdish polities
description: A short-lived Kurdish self-governing unrecognized state in present-day Iran, from 22 January to 15 December 1946.

name: Republic of Malawi
description: Is a landlocked country in Southeastern Africa that was formerly known as Nyasaland. It gained independence from the United Kingdom on 6 July 1964.

name: Sultanate of the Maldive Islands
description: The British Colony over the Maldives ended in 1965 with the independence of the archipelago as the Republic of Maldive Islands.

name: Republic of Maldives
description: Is an archipelagic state in South Asia, situated in the Indian Ocean. It lies southwest of Sri Lanka and India. The archipelago became independent from the United Kingdom in 1965 and was named Republic of Maldives in 1969.

name: Republic of Mali
description: Is a landlocked country in West Africa. A former French Colony, it became indepedent in 1960 and is a Republic since August 1960. Since the start of the Mali War in 2012 the northern portion of the country is fragmented into zones controlled by various rebel groups.

name: Republic of Malta
description: Is an island country in the Mediterranean Sea. It consists of an archipelago, between Italy and Libya. A British possessions since the Napoleonic Wars, it gained independency in 1974.

name: Naro
description: In 1344, the city-state of Uchchakalpa, present-day Unchahara, was founded by Raja Veerraj Judeo when he seized the fort of Naro.

name: Republic of Martyazo
description: Was a short-lived secessionist state proclaimed by Hutu rebels at Vyanda in Burundi in early May 1972.

name: Republic of Mauritius
description: Is an island nation in the Indian Ocean about 2,000 kilometres off the southeast coast of the African continent, east of Madagascar. It gained independency from Great Britain in 1968 and became a Republic on 12 March 1992.

name: Republic of Mirdita
description: Short-lived unrecognized republic declared in northern Albania by Marka Gjoni and his followers. It existed between 17 July and 20 November 1921.

name: Republic of Moldova
description: Is a landlocked country in Eastern Europe. It is bordered by Romania to the west and Ukraine to the north, east, and south. Moldova is one of the countries that emerged from the dissolution of the USSR in 1991. However, the strip of Moldovan territory on the east bank of the Dniester has been under the de facto control of the breakaway government of Transnistria since 1990.

name: Republic of Mountainous Armenia
label: separatists (russian civil war)
description: It was established by a military commander and Armenian political thinker Garegin Nzhdeh and his allies with the support of local guerrilla forces, following the suppression of the February Uprising in April 1921.

name: Republic of Mozambique
description: Is a country located in southeastern Africa bordered by the Indian Ocean to the east, Tanzania to the north, Malawi and Zambia to the northwest, Zimbabwe to the west, and Eswatini and South Africa to the southwest. A former Portuguese colony, Mozambique gained its indpendence from Portugal in 1975. It became a Republic in 1990.

name: Nagorno-Karabakh Republic
description: Was a country in South Caucasus in territories internationally recognised as part of Azerbaijan. The unrecognized Nagorno-Karabakh Republic changed its name to the Republic of Artsakh in 2017 after a constitutional referendum.

name: Republic of Namibia
description: Is a country in southwestern Africa. A former Germany colony, it was occupied by the Western Allies during World War I and then assigned to South Africa as a League of Nations Mandate. Although the mandate was abolished by the United Nations in 1966, South African control over the territory continued despite its illegality under international law. In 1990, South West Africa was granted independence as the Republic of Namibia with the exception of Walvis Bay and the Penguin Islands, which continued to remain under South African rule until 1994.

name: Republic of Nauru
description: Is an island country and microstate in Oceania, in the Central Pacific. On 31 January 1968, following a two-year constitutional convention, Nauru became the world's smallest independent republic.

name: Narsinghpur State
description: Was a polity located in the modern-day Indian State of Odisha.

name: Republic of Niger
description: Is a landlocked country in West Africa. It became independent from France in 1960.

name: Republic of North Ingria
label: separatists (russian civil war)
description: Short-lived, small state for the Ingrian Finns in the southern part of the Karelian Isthmus, which seceded from Bolshevist Russia after the October Revolution. It ruled parts of Northern Ingria from 1919 until 1920.

name: Republic of North Macedonia
description: Macedonia, a landlocked country in Southeast Europe, emerged from the dissolution of Yugoslavia. It became independent after a referendum in 1991. Due to a dispute with Greece, in February 2019 the country renamed iteslf "Republic of North Macedonia".

name: Autonomous Palatinate
description: Was a short-lived unilaterally declared polity in Rhineland-Palatinate during the occupation of German Rhineland.

name: Republic of Palau
description: Is an island country and microstate in the western Pacific. The islands gained full sovereignty in 1994 under a Compact of Free Association with the United States.

name: Republic of Palau
description: Was an U.S. dependency in the Pacific. Initially part of the Trust Territory of the Pacific Islands from 1947, it voted in a referendum against joining the Federated States of Micronesia in 1978 and thus remained under U.S. control until its independency in 1994.

name: Republic of Panama
description: Is a transcontinental country spanning the southern part of North America and the northern part of South America. The separation of Panama from Colombia was formalized on 3 November 1903, with the establishment of the Republic of Panama. The Panama canal zone was controlled by the United States from 1903 to 1979, and was under joint U.S.-Panamian control from 1979 to 1999.

name: Nasiruddin Qabacha
description: Following the death of the first Mumluk Sultan, Qutb al-Din Aibak in 1210, Multan came under the rule of Nasiruddin Qabacha.

name: Republic of Paraguay
description: Is a landlocked country in South America. It is bordered by Argentina to the south and southwest, Brazil to the east and northeast, and Bolivia to the northwest. Paraguay became independent from Spain in 1811, with a larger territory than today. Paraguay lost around one third of its territory to nearby country in the Paraguayan War (1864-1870).

name: Republic of Perloja
description: In November 1918, the locals established a self-governing parish committee, often called the Republic of Perloja (Perlojos respublika), chaired by Jonas Česnulevičius, veteran of the Imperial Russian Army. It was located in modern-day Lithuania.

name: Republic of Peru
description: Is a country in western South America. It is bordered in the north by Ecuador and Colombia, in the east by Brazil, in the southeast by Bolivia, in the south by Chile, and in the south and west by the Pacific Ocean. A former Spanish colony, Peru declared its independency in 1821 but was practically controlled by Chilean and Argentinian troops until 1822.

name: Republic of Peru (Military Occupation)
description: Polity that includes all territories militarly occupied by Peru that are not part of a specific military territory.

name: Republic of Poland
description: Is a country in Central Europe. The country is bordered by Lithuania and Russia to the northeast, Belarus and Ukraine to the east, Slovakia and the Czech Republic to the south, and Germany to the west. A Polih nation exist since the establishment of the Duchy of Poland in 961. After a long period of union with nearby Lithuania (1386-1795), Poland was partitioned between Russia, Prussia and Austria. The country was again independent for a short period during the Napoleonic period (Duchy of Warsaw) before being annexed by Russia. It gained its independence after World War I. At the beginning of World War II it was occupied by Germany. The USSR liberated the country and established a Communist regime that lasted until 1989.

name: Republic of Prekmurje
description: Was an unrecognized state in Prekmurje, an area traditionally known in Hungarian as Vendvidék ("Wendic March").

name: Lord Pskov
label: russian principalities
description: Was a medieval state on the south shore of Lake Pskov. Originally a principality and then a part of the Novgorod Republic, Pskov became an independent republic in 1348. It became a vassal to the Grand Duchy of Moscow in 1380.

name: Nasrid Dynasty
description: Was an Iranian Sunni dynasty that ruled Sistan in the power vacuum left by the collapse of the Ghaznavid Empire. In 1194 the dynasty became a vassal of the Khwarazmian Empire.

name: Republic of Rhodesia
description: In 1965, Southern Rhodesia unilaterally declared itself independent as "Rhodesia" under a white-dominated government led by Ian Smith. In 1970 Rhodesia became officially a Republic.

name: Republic of Rwanda
description: Is a landlocked country in the Great Rift Valley of Central Africa, where the African Great Lakes region and Southeast Africa converge. Rwanda emerged as a country in the the XV century. It gained independence from Belgium in 1959 and became a Republic in 1962.

name: Nawanagar State
description: Was a polity in the historical Halar region, located on the southern shores of the Gulf of Kutch.

name: Nayagarh State
description: Was a polity located in the modern-day Indian State of Odisha.

name: Republic of Senegal
description: Is a country in West Africa, on the Atlantic Ocean coastline. A former French colony, Senegal became independent in 1960.

name: Republic of Serbia
description: Is a landlocked country in Southeastern and Central Europe, situated at the crossroads of the Pannonian Basin and the Balkans. Serbia emerged in 2006 from the dissolution of the State Union of Serbia and Montenegro, which was the last vestige of the state of Yugoslavia. In this model, Serbia is considered the successor of Yugoslavia because, as in other similar cases, we concluded that Serbia was the core or dominant polity of Yugoslavia because (I) The King of Serbia became the King of Yugoslavia when the latter was created frome the merger of several territories, (II) Serbia and Montenegro were the two independent polities that created Yugoslavia with Serbia being the largest of the two, whereas all the other territories were former Austro-Hungarian territories, (III) What remained of Yugoslavia was an union of Serbia and Montenegro after all other countries had seceded, and again Serbia was the dominant of these two entities. From a legal point of view, the UN does not aknowledge Serbia as the legal successor of Yugoslavia.

name: Republic of Serbian Krajina
description: SAO of Krajina declared itself the Republic of Serbian Krajina.

name: Republic of Seychelles
description: Is an archipelagic state consisting of 115 islands in the Indian Ocean. A former British colony, the Seychelles became independent in 1977.

name: Republic of Sierra Leone
description: Is a country on the southwest coast of West Africa. It gained independence from the United Kingdom in 1961 and became the Republic of Sierra Leone on 19 April 1971.

name: Republic of Singapore
description: Is a sovereign island country and city-state in maritime Southeast Asia. A former British Colony, in 1963 Singapore merged with Malaya, Sarawak and North Borneo to form the independent country of Malaysia. The union was unstable due to distrust and ideological differences between the leaders of Singapore and of the federal government of Malaysia. These culminated in the decision by Malaysian Prime Minister Tunku Abdul Rahman to expel Singapore from the Federation, and on 9 August 1965, Singapore became independent.

name: Republic of Slovenia
description: Is a country in Central Europe. In June 1991, Slovenia became the first republic to split from Yugoslavia.

name: Federal Republic of Somalia
description: Is a country in the Horn of Africa. Somalia gained independency from Italy and the United Kingdom in 1960. The current Republic occured in 1991 duing the Somali Civil War. The northern portion of the country is de facto controlled by the independent Republic of Somaliland since 1991.

name: Republic of Somaliland
description: Is an unrecognised de facto sovereign state in the Horn of Africa, still considered internationally to be part of Somalia.

name: Nayakas of Chitradurga
description: Was a dynasty that ruled parts of eastern Karnataka during the post-Vijayanagara period.

name: Republic of South Africa
description: Is the southernmost country in Africa. The creation of a state in South Africa can be dated back to the establishemnt of the Dutch Cape Colony in 1652. The modern republic was established when the Union of South Africa came to an end with the enactment of the constitution of 1961. An ethnically diverse country, the european minority descended from Dutch and British colonists imposed a regime of racial segregation (Apartheid) that ended in 1994. In the same period, the borders of South Africa did also change considerably: South Africa allowed Namibia to become an independent country, left Walvis Bay (a territory under direct control of South Africa now also part of Namibia), and abolished the "Black Homelands" (or "Bantustans"), territories set aside for Black inhabitants of South Africa and Namibia as part of the Apartheid policy.

name: Republic of South Maluku
description: Was an unrecognised secessionist republic that claimed the islands of Ambon, Buru, and Seram, which make up the Indonesian province of Maluku.

name: Republic of South Ossetia - the State of Alania
description: Is a partially recognised landlocked state in the South Caucasus. It emerged in 1991 from the dissolution of the Soviet Union.

name: Republic of South Sudan
description: Is a landlocked country in Eastern Africa. It gained independence from Sudan on 9 July 2011.

name: Nayaks of Gingee
description: Was a dynasty that became independent after the dissolution of the Vijayanagara Empire. Their territories were located in Tamil Nadu, southern India.

name: Republic of Stellaland
label: boer states
description: Was a Boer Republic (independent republics formed by Durch-speaking inhabitants of the Cape Colony that wanted to be independent from the British Cape Colony).

name: Republic of Suriname
description: Is a country in northern South America. It is bordered by the Atlantic Ocean to the north, French Guiana to the east, Guyana to the west, and Brazil to the south. The region was colonized by the Dutch from 1667. The country became fully independent as the Republic of Suriname on 25 November 1975.

name: Republic of Swellendam
label: boer states
description: By 1795 the dissatisfaction towards the Dutch East India Company caused the burghers of Swellendam to revolt, and on 17 June 1795 they declared themselves a Republic.

name: Republic of Tajikistan
description: Is a country in Central Asia. On 9 September 1991, Tajikistan became an independent sovereign nation when the Soviet Union disintegrated.

name: Republic of Tamrash
description: Was a short-lived self-governing administrative structure of the Pomaks, living in the Tamrash region of the Rhodope Mountains.

name: Republic of Tanganyika
description: A sovereign state, comprising the mainland part of present-day Tanzania, that gained independence from the United Kingdom on 9 December 1961. It became a Republic on December 9, 1962.

name: Republic of Tarnobrzeg
description: Short-lived entity, proclaimed 6 November 1918 in the Polish town of Tarnobrzeg.

name: Ndwandwe Kingdom
description: Was a kingdom in Zululand (South Africa) in the first half of the XIX century.

name: Republic of the Congo
description: A country in central Africa, it gained its independence from France in 1960. It is bordered to the west by Gabon, to its northwest by Cameroon and its northeast by the Central African Republic, to the southeast by the Democratic Republic of the Congo, to its south by the Angolan exclave of Cabinda and to its southwest by the Atlantic Ocean.

name: Republic of the Congo
description: Was a sovereign state in Central Africa, created with the independence of the Belgian Congo in 1960. From 1960 to 1966, the country was also known as Congo-Léopoldville (after its capital) to distinguish it from its northwestern neighbor, which is also called the Republic of the Congo, alternatively known as "Congo-Brazzaville".

name: Republic of the Gambia
description: Is a country on the Atlantic coast of Western Africa, completely surrounded by Senegal. It gained independence from the United Kingdom in 1965.

name: Republic of the Marshall Islands
description: Is an island country near the Equator in the Pacific Ocean. The islands were conquered by the U.S.A. during World War II. On October 21, 1986, the U.S. ended its administration and the Marhsall islands became independent.

name: Republic of the North Solomons
description: The Republic of the North Solomons was an unrecognised state that purported to exist for about six months in what is now the Autonomous Region of Bougainville, Papua New Guinea.

name: Republic of the Philippines
description: Is an archipelagic country in Southeast Asia. Formerly a Spanish Colony, it became briefly independent in parts of its territories during the Philippine Revolution (1896-1898) but was occupied by the United States during the Spanish-American war (18989) shortly after. The Treaty of Manila in 1946 established the independent Philippine Republic.

name: Negara Daha
description: Negara Daha was a Hindu kingdom now located in the Regency of Hulu Sungai Selatan.

name: Inca Empire
description: Was a successor state of the Inca Empire founded to flee from Spanish domination. The Neo-Inca State lasted until 1572, when the last Inca stronghold was conquered, and the last ruler, Túpac Amaru, was captured and executed by the Spanish.

name: Kingdom of Nepal
description: The short period where Nepal was effectively a Tributary to the Qing Dynasty.

name: Neutral Ground
description: The Neutral Ground (also known as the Neutral Strip, the Neutral Territory, and the No Man's Land of Louisiana; sometimes anachronistically referred to as the Sabine Free State) was a disputed area between Spanish Texas and the United States' newly acquired Louisiana Purchase. Local officers of Spain and the United States agreed to leave the Neutral Ground temporarily outside the jurisdiction of either country. The area, now in western Louisiana, had neutral status from 1806 to 1821.

name: New Granada Semi-Independent Juntas
label: juntas
description: Were the independent Juntas of modern-day Colombia during the early phases of the Colombian struggle for independence from Spain.

name: Republic of the Sudan
description: Is a country in Northeast Africa. Sudan become an independent sovereign state on 1 January 1956, gaining independence from the United Kingdom. In 2011 the southern part of the country became independent as "South Sudan" after a referendum.

name: Republic of the Union of Myanmar
description: Is a country in Southeast Asia. It is bordered by Bangladesh and India to its northwest, China to its northeast, Laos and Thailand to its east and southeast. The country gained independence fomr the United Kingdom in 1948. The actual denomination was introduced in 2008.

name: Republic of the United States of Brazil
description: The Empire of Brazil became a Republic after the deposition of Emperoro Pedro II in 1889.

name: Republic of Trinidad and Tobago
description: Is the southernmost island country in the Caribbean. It consists of the main islands Trinidad and Tobago. The country gained its independency from the United Kingdom in 1962 and became a republic in 1976.

name: Republic of Tule
description: The Guna indigenous people revolted against the Panamian Authorities and proclaimed the revolutionary Republic of Tule.

name: Republic of Tunisia
description: Is the northernmost country in Africa. It is a part of the Maghreb. Tunisia gained its independency from France in 1956 and became a Republic in 1957. The city of Bizerte initially remained a French possession, but was finally handed over to Tunisia in 1963.

name: Republic of Turkey
description: Turkey is a country that controls most of the Anatolian Pensinsula and a small portion of the Balkan Peninsula in Southeast Europe. The Republic of Turkey emerged after World War I, when it was formally declared on 29 October 1923 as the successor state of the Ottoman Empire. In 2022 the Republic of Turkey changed its official English name to the Republic of Türkiye.

name: Republic of Türkiye
description: Turkey is a country that controls most of the Anatolian Pensinsula and a small portion of the Balkan Peninsula in Southeast Europe. The Republic of Turkey emerged after World War I, when it was formally declared on 29 October 1923 as the successor state of the Ottoman Empire. In 2022 the Republic of Turkey changed its official English name to the Republic of Türkiye.

name: Ngô Dynasty
description: Was a dynasty that ruled over northern Vietnam after putting an end to centuries of Chinese imperial domination in Vietnam.

name: Republic of Uganda
description: Is a landlocked country in East Africa that derives its name from Buganda, a precolonial Kingdom that occupied part of the territory of present-day Uganda. It became independent from the United Kingdom in 1963.

name: Republic of Uhtua
label: separatists (russian civil war)
description: Was a short-lived state in Karelia duirng the Russian Civil War.

name: Republic of Upingtonia
label: boer states
description: Was a short-lived Boer republic in the area of present-day Namibia. It was originally named Upingtonia, but changed its name to Lijdensrust.

name: Republic of Upper Volta
description: Upper Volta was made a self-governing colony in 1958 as the Republic of Upper Volta, before gaining full independence from France 2 years later.

name: Republic of Upper Volta
description: Upper Volta was made a self-governing colony in 1958 as the Republic of Upper Volta, before gaining full independence from France 2 years later.

name: Republic of Utrecht
label: boer states
description: Was a Boer Republic (independent republics formed by Durch-speaking inhabitants of the Cape Colony that wanted to be independent from the British Cape Colony).

name: Republic of Uzbekistan
description: Is a country located in Central Asia. It emerged form the dissolution of the Soviet Union in 1991.

name: Republic of Užice
description: The Republic of Užice was a short-lived liberated Yugoslav territory and the first liberated territory in World War II Europe, organized as a military mini-state that existed in the autumn of 1941.

name: Republic of Vanuatu
description: Is an island country located in the South Pacific Ocean. Vanuatu became a shared condominium (the New Hebrides) of France and Great Britain in the XIX century. It gained independence in 1980.

name: Republic of Venezuela
description: The constitution of 1953 renamed the country of Venezuela to "Republic of Venezuela".

name: Republic of Vietnam
description: Was a country that existed from 1955 to 1975 and controlled the southern portion of Vietnam. It was a member of the Western Bloc during part of the Cold War after the 1954 division of Vietnam. Communist forces overran Saigon on 30 April 1975, marking the end of the Republic of Vietnam.

name: Nikapitiya's Rebels
description: In December 1616 a greater revolt broke out in eastern Seven Korales, at the time part of Portuguese Ceylon.

name: Republic of Western Bosnia
description: A small unrecognised state that existed in the northwest of Bosnia and Herzegovina between 1993 and 1995. It consisted of the town of Velika Kladuša (its capital) and a few nearby villages. It was proclaimed as a result of secessionist politics by former Bosnian president Fikret Abdić against the central government of Alija Izetbegovic during the Bosnian War.

name: Republic of Winburg-Potchefstroom
label: boer states
description: Was a Boer Republic (independent republics formed by Durch-speaking inhabitants of the Cape Colony that wanted to be independent from the British Cape Colony). It was located in Transvaal.

name: Republic of Yemen
description: Is a country controlling the southwestern part of the Arabian Peninsula. Yemen emerged from the union of North and South Yemen, on May 22, 1990.

name: Republic of Zaire
description: Was a Congolese state from 1971 to 1997 in Central Africa that was previously and is now again known as the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

name: Republic of Zakopane
description: On October 30, the Organisation officially declared its independence from Austria-Hungary and, two days later, made itself a "National Council".

name: Republic of Zambia
description: Is a country in south central Africa. Zambia became independent from the United Kingdom in 1964.

name: Republic of Zamboanga
description: Was a Republic originated in Zamboanga (Philippines) during the Philippine Revolution.

name: Republic of Zimbabwe
description: Is a landlocked country in Southern Africa, between the Zambezi and Limpopo Rivers. Zimbabwe initally gained its independence as Rhodesia, a country ruled by its white minority. The minority rule ended in 1979. The current Republic of Zimbabwe was declared in 1980.

name: Zimbabwe Rhodesia
description: Rhodesia had unilaterally declared independence from the United Kingdom in 1965 to become a white-only governed country. Under pressure from the international community, and due to the ethnical unrest caused by the minority rule, Rhodesia made an agreement with the black community and changed the name of the country into Zimbabwe-Rhodesia.

name: Nilgiri State
description: Was a polity located in the modern-day Indian State of Odisha.

name: Republic of Lydenburg
label: boer states
description: Was a Boer Republic (independent republics formed by Durch-speaking inhabitants of the Cape Colony that wanted to be independent from the British Cape Colony).

name: Nizari Ismaili State
description: Under the leadership of Hassan-i Sabbah the Nizari Ismaili created a state of unconnected fortresses in Persia and Syria, surrounded by huge swathes of hostile territory.

name: Republika Srpska
description: Republika Srpska was formed in 1992 at the outset of the Bosnian War with the stated intent to safeguard the interests of the Serbs of Bosnia and Herzegovina. In this period it was practically an independent polity.

name: Nogai Horde
description: Was a confederation founded by the Nogais that occupied the Pontic-Caspian steppe from about 1500 until they were pushed west by the Kalmyks and south by the Russians in the 17th century.

name: Norman State in Brittany
label: norse/viking polities
description: Brittany was occupied by the Norsemen for twenty years.

name: Colony of Réunion
description: Was a French Colony in the Indian Ocean. The island changed name several times, being called Île Bourbon or Île Bonaparte in the past. It was permanently renamed Réunion after the fall of the July monarchy by a decree of the provisional government on 7 March 1848. In 1946 Réunion became a French overseas department.

name: Colony of Réunion
description: The period of the colony when it was loyal to Vichy France.

name: Revala
label: ancient estonian counties
description: An Ancient Estonian country of the Middle Ages.

name: Kingdom of the West Franks
label: barbarian kingdoms;frankish polities
description: In April 879, Louis the Stammerer, Emperor of West Francia, died. The Empire was divided between his sons Louis III and Carloman II with the Treaty of Ribemont (880).

name: Kingdom of the West Franks
label: barbarian kingdoms;frankish polities
description: After Louis and Carloman divided West Francia at Amiens in March 880, the two brothers joined to march against Boso, the King of Provence that had secded from West Francia. The conquered territory were administered jointly. However, soon Boso was able to conquer back these territories.

name: Rewa State
label: indian princely states
description: Was an Indian princely state located in the modern-day Indian State of Madhya Pradesh.

name: Rey Bouba Sultanate
description: Was a precolonial polity in Cameroon.

name: Rhaukos
label: greek poleis
description: A Greek polis in ancient Crete.

name: Rhegion
label: greek poleis
description: A Greek polis in Magna Graecia.

name: Rheneia
label: greek poleis
description: A Greek polis in the ancient Cyclades.

name: Rhenish Republic
description: Was proclaimed at Aachen (Aix-la-Chapelle) in October 1923 during the occupation of the Ruhr by troops from France and Belgium (January 1923 - 1925).

name: Rhithymnos
label: greek poleis
description: A Greek polis in ancient Crete.

name: Rhitten
label: greek poleis
description: A Greek polis in ancient Crete.

name: Rhizous
label: greek poleis
description: A Greek polis in the ancient region of Magnesia.
